{{Quote|The Empire has wasted no time in assembling a fleet to retake the planet. If they were to reach Mon Calamari, the devastation to the planet would be catastrophic.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
During the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the shipyards over [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] began production of new ships for use in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. In an attempt to stop them from using the ships, a massive Imperial fleet, spear-headed by three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]], including the [[Emancipator|''Accuser'']], '''attempted to destroy''' the shipyards before any cruisers were completed.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We have informants in place to alert us when the fleet gets underway. We must not waste a moment in preparing for this assault.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="EaW" />}}
Using Han Solo to capture plans for [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] was a success, and shipyards over Dac began production of the cruisers. However, the Alliance discovered that a major Imperial fleet was massing over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], with the intent of invading Mon Calamari. Allowing this to happen was not an option.

Sending a detachment of their own fleet to join five Mon Calamari Cruisers, including [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']], over Mon Calamari, [[Alliance Space Station]]s were set up along hyperspace routes to stop the enemy's advance.

==The battle==
The Alliance's fleet intercepted the enemy before it could get to its destination. Brutal fighting began, with both sides taking casualties. However, the rebels had the advantage, due to the space station, and the Imperials were losing the battle.

The new rebel cruisers proved their worth, as they managed to destroy the enemy flagships. Coupled with the rebel starfighters, the ships destroyed the Imperial Star Destroyers, and with them down, the rest of the Imperial fleet fell quickly.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Our victory over the Empire's fleet is cause for celebration, but I find it disturbing that they appear almost unconcerned with the loss of ships and personnel. Perhaps... they no longer need the ships.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The destruction of the invading fleet meant that the rebels significantly upgraded the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Even though the ''Accuser'' was hastily repaired, the rebel were clearly capable of destroying Imperial Star Destroyers.

However, Mon Mothma was unnerved by how apparently unconcerned the Galactic Empire seemed about the loss of such a large fleet. She thought that the Empire must have a plan to destroy the Rebellion. She was proven correct shortly afterward, as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|attempted]] to destroy [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the eleventh mission of the Rebel campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.
